props.title: Performing is a team sport — run by a ==team of one==.

left.label: Generic AI
left.title: Knows nothing of the craft
points: No sense of method, misdirection, or stakes
Ignores stage timing, pacing, and applause beats
Writes patter that reads well — and plays badly

right.label: The working magician
right.title: Does it all alone
points: Writes every script and line of patter solo
Structures shows with no second opinion
Prepares the business side after midnight

slides.notes: Two problems compound: the magician is a solo creator, and generic AI tools are useless for performance craft. Neither side understands the other.

props.title: A workspace shaped like a ==magician's week==.

items.title: Develop routines
items.body: Turn an effect or a rough idea into material with real shape — structure, arcs, and beats.

items.title: Write and refine patter
items.body: Scripts and patter drafted, tightened, and rehearsed until they play as well as they read.

items.title: Structure the show
items.body: Order, transitions, and pacing across the whole set — not just one trick in isolation.

items.title: Prepare the business
items.body: The performing life around the show: promotion, clients, and the materials bookings require.

slides.notes: Four pillars, one workflow. Magic Manta isn't a chatbot bolted onto magic — it's a workspace arranged around how a performer actually spends the week.

messages.text: I want to build a close-up routine around a borrowed ring.
Strong premise. Let's give it shape: three phases, a rising emotional arc, and one clean impossibility at the end. Shall I draft the structure?
Yes — and tighten the patter for the reveal.
Here's a full script with beats timed to the moves, transitions between phases, and rehearsal notes for the moments that need the most practice.

slides.notes: Walk the arc out loud: the performer brings an effect or an idea; Magic Manta returns structure, script, transitions, and rehearsal notes. It ends in material you can actually perform.

props.label: Craft-first design
props.text: Built with a working performer's respect for ==secrets==. Magic Manta supports the creative process — and never exposes the method.

slides.notes: This is the trust beat. Pause here. The magicians' community only adopts tools that respect the sanctity of the method — that respect is designed in, not promised.
